requirement_understanding: The Customer Master module allows enterprise users to manage customer records within the Master Data section of the Ambica platform. The module supports full CRUD operations (Create, Read/View, Update, Delete) for customer records including Party Code, Customer Name, Country, State, and Region fields, with strict validations against duplicate records and required field constraints.
requirement_gaps: Unclear field level constraints (e.g., min/max character lengths for Party Code, Customer Name, Region).
Lack of clear spec on numeric vs alphanumeric validation for Region field.
Soft delete vs hard delete business rule specifications not defined in recorded flow.
No visible search/filter criteria documented for navigating large datasets in Customer Master table.
business_rules: Party Code must be unique across all customer records.
Party Code and Customer Name are mandatory fields for customer creation.
Updating a customer record must maintain database integrity and reflect immediately in the customer list table.
Deletion of a customer record requires explicit user confirmation via dialog modal.
assumptions: User is pre-authenticated with required roles (e.g. Master Data Admin / Manager).
The environment URL is accessible and database seed data includes existing records such as 'HTM001'.
UI components utilize PrimeNG (p-dialog, p-toast) or similar UI frameworks.
risks: Duplicate key errors or uncaught server exceptions when submitting duplicate Party Codes.
Accidental permanent deletion of customer records if confirmation modal fails or is missing authorization checks.
Unsanitized input in Customer Name or Region leading to XSS vulnerabilities.
modules_impacted: Sales Order Entry / Quotations (dependent on Customer Master)

test_strategy.objectives: Validate full end-to-end functionality of Customer Master including full CRUD cycle, duplicate checks, isolated boundary inputs, modal behaviors, and API/DB state synchronization.
test_strategy.scope_in: Navigation, Add Customer form validations, Field isolation tests (Party Code, Name, Country, State, Region), View dialog, Edit functionality, Delete & Confirmation dialogs, Duplicate validation error toasts.
test_strategy.scope_out: Authentication, SSO login flows, role permissions provisioning, backend database migration performance.
test_strategy.rollback_plan: Execute automated cleanup scripts post-test execution to remove created test customer records from the database.

test_scenarios: Create a new customer with valid data (CRUD - Create)
Update an existing customer record (CRUD - Update)
Delete a customer record with confirmation (CRUD - Delete)
Attempt to create customer with duplicate Party Code (Negative Duplicate)
Validate required field Party Code in isolation (Negative Validation)
Validate required field Customer Name in isolation (Negative Validation)
Validate Country field isolated input (Negative Validation)
Validate State field isolated input (Negative Validation)
Validate boundary limits on Party Code field (Boundary Test)
Validate boundary limits on Region field (Boundary Test)
Cancel Add Customer modal form (UI Flow)

from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_customer_master_crud(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/ambica/auth/login')
    page.click('button:has-text("Master Data")')
    page.click('a:has-text("Customer Master")')
    page.click('button:has-text("Add Customer")')
    page.fill('#partyCode', 'AUTOMATION_01')
    page.fill('#customerName', 'Auto Customer')
    page.fill('#country', 'India')
    page.fill('#state', 'Maharashtra')
    page.fill('#region', 'West')
    page.click('button:has-text("Submit")')
    expect(page.locator('table')).to_contain_text('AUTOMATION_01')

documentation_markdown:
# Customer Master Module QA Documentation

## Overview
The Customer Master module allows administrative users to view, create, edit, and delete customer entity records.

## Workflow Steps
1. **Navigate**: Master Data -> Customer Master.
2. **Add Customer**: Click 'Add Customer', fill in Party Code, Name, Country, State, Region, and submit.
3. **View/Edit**: Click record row buttons to open details view or update details.
4. **Delete**: Click delete action button and confirm via popup.
